verses.text: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

segments.text: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto
my
soul.

verses.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

segments.text: I sink in deep mire, where
there is
no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

notes: 69.2 deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth
69.2 deep waters: Heb. depth of waters

verses.text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

segments.text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

segments.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me,
being
mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored
that
which I took not away.

verses.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

segments.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.text: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

segments.text: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

segments.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

segments.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

segments.text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.text: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

segments.text: When I wept,
and chastened
my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

segments.text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

segments.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I
was
the song of the drunkards.

notes: 69.12 drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink

verses.text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

segments.text: But as for me, my prayer
is
unto thee, O LORD,
in
an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

segments.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

segments.text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.text: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

segments.text: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness
is
good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

segments.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

notes: 69.17 hear…: Heb. make haste to hear me

verses.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

segments.text: Draw nigh unto my soul,
and
redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.text: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

segments.text: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries
are
all before thee.

verses.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

segments.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked
for some
to take pity, but
there was
none; and for comforters, but I found none.

notes: 69.20 to take…: Heb. to lament with me

verses.text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

segments.text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.text: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

segments.text: Let their table become a snare before them: and
that which should have been
for
their
welfare,
let it become
a trap.

verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

segments.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

segments.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.text: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

segments.text: Let their habitation be desolate;
and
let none dwell in their tents.

notes: 69.25 let none…: Heb. let there not be a dweller

verses.text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

segments.text: For they persecute
him
whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

segments.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

notes: 69.27 iniquity unto…: or, punishment of iniquity, etc

verses.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

segments.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.text: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

segments.text: But I
am
poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

segments.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.text: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

segments.text: This
also shall please the LORD better than an ox
or
bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.text: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

segments.text: The humble shall see
this, and
be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.text: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

segments.text: For the  LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

segments.text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

segments.text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

segments.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Psalm of David.
